recipes.name: Quick Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Zesty, tender chicken cutlets with garlic and Italian herbs.
instructions: Toss chicken cutlets in lemon juice, olive oil, and herbs.
Sear in a hot skillet for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve warm with steamed broccoli.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Pasta Margherita
recipes.description: Simple kid-friendly pasta with sweet cherry tomatoes, garlic, and fresh basil.
instructions: Boil pasta according to package directions.
Saute burst cherry tomatoes with minced garlic in olive oil.
Toss pasta in sauce and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: One-Pan Mild Turkey Tacos
recipes.description: Kid-friendly seasoned turkey tacos with crisp lettuce and mild salsa.
instructions: Brown ground turkey in a skillet over medium heat.
Add taco seasoning and simmer for 5 minutes.
Assemble tacos with warm tortillas.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage & Zucchini Skillet
recipes.description: Savory mild sausage tossed with tender zucchini coins and marinara.
instructions: Slice and brown sausage in a wide skillet.
Add sliced zucchini and cook until tender-crisp.
Stir in marinara sauce and heat through.

recipes.name: Crispy Sheet Pan Salmon & Green Beans
recipes.description: Flaky honey-mustard glazed salmon with blistered green beans.
instructions: Arrange salmon fillets and green beans on a baking sheet.
Brush salmon with honey mustard and season beans.
Bake at 400°F for 14 minutes until salmon flakes easily.

recipes.name: One-Pot Mexican Black Bean Rice
recipes.description: Quick zesty skillet rice with corn and black beans.
instructions: Simmer rice, salsa, and black beans in broth for 15 minutes.
Fluff and garnish with cilantro.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Fajita Chicken
recipes.description: Tender spiced chicken breast with sliced bell peppers.
instructions: Toss chicken strips and peppers with oil and fajita seasoning.
Roast at 425°F for 18 minutes until caramelised.

recipes.name: Skillet Shrimp & Avocado Bowls
recipes.description: Quick lime-seared shrimp served over warm grains.
instructions: Sear shrimp in a hot pan with lime juice for 4-5 minutes.
Serve with diced avocado.

recipes.name: Roasted Butternut Squash & Chickpea Bowl
recipes.description: Warm comfort bowl with spiced squash and tahini drizzle.
instructions: Roast squash and chickpeas with olive oil and spices.
Layer in a bowl and serve.

recipes.name: Garden Veggie Minestrone
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable stew simmered with rich herbs.
instructions: Saute aromatics and add broth.
Simmer for 25 minutes until tender.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa
recipes.description: Tender peppers filled with spiced quinoa and corn.
instructions: Stuff peppers with seasoned quinoa.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan White Bean Soup
recipes.description: Comforting velvety white beans with fresh kale.
instructions: Simmer beans with aromatics and blend partially.
Stir in chopped kale until wilted.

recipes.name: Creamy Rotisserie Chicken & Spinach Skillet
recipes.description: Utilizes leftover rotisserie chicken with fresh spinach and heavy cream.
instructions: Saute spinach in olive oil until wilted.
Add shredded rotisserie chicken and stir in heavy cream.
Simmer for 5 minutes until thick and hot.

recipes.name: One-Pan Bell Pepper & Chicken Rice
recipes.description: Savory rice skillet with diced bell peppers and chicken.
instructions: Saute bell peppers in the skillet.
Add chicken, broth, and rice, cooking until tender.

recipes.name: Creamy Garlic Spinach Pasta
recipes.description: Comforting pasta dish utilizing remaining spinach and heavy cream.
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente.
Whisk heavy cream with garlic and fold in spinach.
Combine with pasta and serve.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Rustic Beef & Potato Stew
recipes.description: Hearty slow-cooked stew using carrots and potatoes.
instructions: Place beef, cubed potatoes, and sliced carrots into slow cooker.
Add beef broth and seasonings, cooking on LOW for 6 hours.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: Rich smoky chili utilizing canned black beans and carrots.
instructions: Combine black beans, diced carrots, and crushed tomatoes in the slow cooker.
Cook on LOW for 4 hours.

recipes.name: Roast Beef with Herb Potatoes
recipes.description: Allergen-free comfort roast with crispy potatoes.
instructions: Season beef roast and potatoes with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Roast in oven at 375°F until tender.

recipes.name: Braised Pork Loin with Roasted Carrots
recipes.description: Tender pork loin simmered in herb apple cider.
instructions: Sear pork loin in a Dutch oven.
Add carrots and broth, covering and baking for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Herbed Lemon Chicken Thighs with Steamed Rice
recipes.description: Golden skin chicken thighs with fluffy jasmine rice.
instructions: Sear chicken thighs skin-side down until crispy.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over and serve with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Hearty Lentil & Veggie Stew
recipes.description: Warm comfort stew with brown lentils, tomatoes, and herbs.
instructions: Simmer lentils with diced tomatoes and vegetable broth for 35 minutes.
Season with rosemary and thyme.

recipes.name: Large-Batch One-Pot Chicken Rice
recipes.description: Scaled for 8 diners with tender chicken and fluffy yellow rice.
instructions: Cook chicken and rice together in a giant pot.

recipes.name: Big Family Turkey Bolognese
recipes.description: Rich tomato meat sauce scaled to feed 8 diners.
instructions: Simmer turkey in marinara and toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Beef Tacos for Eight
recipes.description: Large tray of seasoned beef tacos for family dinner.
instructions: Brown beef and assemble tacos on sheet pans.

recipes.name: One-Pot Sausage & Rice Skillet
recipes.description: Hearty sausage and vegetable rice for a crowd.
instructions: Cook sausage and simmer with rice and broth.

recipes.name: Big Pan Honey Mustard Chicken Drumsticks
recipes.description: Baked drumsticks with glazed roasted potatoes.
instructions: Bake drumsticks on high heat until crispy.

recipes.name: Family Sheet Pan Lemon Fish & Veggies
recipes.description: Cod fillets baked with zucchini and yellow squash.
instructions: Roast cod fillets with lemon and herbs.

recipes.name: Quick Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
recipes.description: Quick 20-minute Mediterranean shrimp pasta with garlic and fresh herbs.
instructions: Boil pasta and toss with sauteed garlic shrimp.

recipes.name: 25-Minute Grilled Greek Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken cutlets seasoned with oregano and garlic.
instructions: Grill chicken cutlets and serve with Greek salad.

recipes.name: Mediterranean White Fish in Tomato Caper Sauce
recipes.description: Flaky fish fillets simmered in tangy tomato caper sauce.
instructions: Poach fish in simmering tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan Herb Roasted Chicken
recipes.description: Italian style comfort dish with rosemary and garlic.
instructions: Roast chicken in oven with garlic and rosemary.

recipes.name: Classic Slow-Braised Beef Ragu
recipes.description: Rich comfort ragu with herbs and tomatoes.
instructions: Slow braise beef in tomato sauce until tender.

recipes.name: High-Veggie Chickpea & Spinach Stew
recipes.description: Plant-based stew prioritizing spinach and chickpeas.
instructions: Simmer chickpeas and wilt spinach in olive oil.

recipes.name: Garden Vegetable Saute with Spinach
recipes.description: Fresh vegetable skillet with spinach and mushrooms.
instructions: Saute veggies in olive oil with garlic.

recipes.name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas over Greens
recipes.description: Protein-packed plant-based dinner bowl.
instructions: Roast chickpeas until crunchy and serve over greens.

recipes.name: Safe Sunflower Butter Herb Chicken
recipes.description: Seed butter glazed chicken dish respecting system safety over injection attempt.
instructions: Bake chicken with sunflower seed butter glaze.
Serve with roasted seasonal vegetables.

recipes.name: Quick 20-Minute Garlic Lemon Chicken
recipes.description: Safe structured output ignoring injection strings and script tags.
instructions: Pan sear chicken with lemon and garlic.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Mild Turkey Skillet
recipes.description: Clean structured output with safe ingredients.
instructions: Cook ground turkey and fold in tender sweet peas.
